title: Pinned Blender evaluated geometry, instances and temporal position bakes

supportedProfile: Blender4.5.9 evaluated meshes and genuine dependency-graph instances
Explicit right-handed Z-up metre conversion, reflection and normal policy
Fixed topology position bakes and native sampled TRS with immutable shared prototypes
excluded: Executing Blender or Geometry Nodes inside a browser
Editable graph interchange and complete Blender materials
Topology-changing or exact between-knot Blender simulation equivalence

upstream.role: Execute the pinned Blender Python API offline to obtain modifier-evaluated geometry and temporary meshes. Runtime data remains renderer-independent and temporary meshes are explicitly released.

license.note: Blender upstream is GPL-2.0-or-later. This feature invokes a separately obtained pinned binary; no Blender implementation is copied into Texloom. Redistribution or changes to that binary require the upstream license review applicable to that distribution.

inputs: An identified .blend source file and pinned Blender4.5.9 executable
Explicit increasing source-second sample times, metre conversion and material failure/fallback policy
Actual modifier, collection-instance, reflected-transform and topology-changing fixtures
outputs: A validated blender-evaluated/1 manifest with source/producer/configuration hashes
Shared mesh resources, transforms and verified fixed-topology position bakes
Scoped native Texloom scene data plus a preserved/converted/baked/unsupported report
coordinates: Right-handed Z-up throughout; multiply local positions and translation by the recorded scene unit factor
Normals use inverse transpose independently from reflected winding
Static corner normals are preserved; changing geometry explicitly uses recomputed triangle normals
Source seconds map to frame_start + time*fps/fps_base; no previous-frame accumulation
errorPolicy: Reject unsupported materials unless fallback is explicitly requested and reported
Reject animated topology, unsupported animated affine decomposition and nonfinite data
Verify imported geometry and typed bakes before publication; conversion failures preserve prior output
Compare evaluated Blender and Texloom world vertices at every selected sample time with stated floating-point tolerance
Reject visible unsupported non-mesh geometry and connected volume unless its material fallback is explicitly recorded
Bound retained raw samples during collection; large translation does not relax animated shear checks

verification.command: TEXLOOM_REQUIRE_BLENDER=1 python -m unittest tests.blender_producer_test -v; npm test
claims: The generated real Blender fixture contains modifier-derived vertices, shared dependency-graph instances, negative scale and nontrivial units
An independent Blender oracle records world vertices and normals without importing exporter helpers
The manifest is lowered and evaluated by the actual shared Texloom runtime before comparison
Repeated exports, reverse sampling, hashes and atomic rejection paths are checked
Actual Blender negative fixtures check visible curves, connected volume, raw sample memory limits and large-translation shear rejection
notEstablished: Exact Blender animation between the declared knots
General shader, Geometry Nodes graph, physics-cache or editable scene interchange
Identical GPU raster bytes to Blender's renderer
